reported.title: Missing debounce on door closed sense
reported.description: The door closed sense on D3 does not have debounce logic, which could lead to false triggering of the lock state when the door is opened or closed rapidly.

reported.title: Timing issue on unlock delay
reported.description: The unlock action is executed immediately when the door opens, which may not respect the 200 ms delay requirement for unlocking.

judge_input.spec:
- Request button on D2 (pull-up); door-closed sense on D3 (pull-up, closed = LOW); lock solenoid on D9.
- Lock D9 engages (HIGH) when request D2 is pressed while door D3 is closed (LOW).
- Unlock (D9 LOW) when the door opens (D3 HIGH); unlock within 200 ms of door open.
- Debounce the request contact with 35 ms of stability before engaging.
- Print `vault lock=<0|1> engages=<n>` every 1000 ms.
- Do not re-engage while already locked; wait for a new request after unlock.
